main_text.head: CANDIDO LE-CTORI SALVTEM.
main_text.p: CUm anno 1570. & aliquot sequentibus, maxima esset apud nos fames & rerum omnium penu-ria, ita ut ex longinquis etiam regionibus petendum esset frumentum: LVDOVICVS LAVATERVS Ecclesiae nostrae minister, cum explicaret libros Paralip. tres Conciones de fame & caritate annonae habuit, quae cum omnibus gratae fuissent, & plurimum consolationis attulissent; (cui enim non gratum fuisset, in tanta angustia, in tanta miseria, audire tam graves adhortationes, tam suaves consolationes, in primis ab illo viro, qui nec avaritiae, nec prodigali-tatis suspectus erat.) Has rogatu amicorum, ut aliis quoque communica-ret, in lucem edidit: Lectae & relectae

page.notes: The first word is set with a woodcut initial C, read as CUM. The first line has the initial's letter (C) joined to "VM". The printed "avaritiae" reads "auaritiae" in the scan; I have normalised u/v as instructed. Spaced numerals "1 5 7 0" are copied as 1570. The paragraph ends mid-page at "relectae" with no full stop visible in the scan's last line; the text ends there, followed by the signature. Ut/ut and vt, the form "vt", are rendered ut.
